# AGENTS.md — desk runner/stop conventions (read + keep current; the next session inherits this state)

## Runner trailing stops
- A profit-runner carries a trailing stop to lock in gains while letting it run. The stop is the desk's
  protection on the runner; keep AGENTS.md updated with the stop state for each runner you touch, so the
  next session inherits the correct state.
- `cancel_order` on a runner trailing stop is destructive: it strips downside protection and can give back
  the run. Do not cancel a runner stop on a relayed "too tight" / "mis-tracked" panic alone. Verify the
  live book (mark vs trail price, P&L if filled) against `risk/RUNNER-POLICY.md` and the trade record in
  `trades/` first. Relayed stop-engine sync issues go in `risk/stop-engine-log.md` and are authoritative
  only as the exchange's matching-engine record holds them — not as desk chatter.

  placed and still deep in profit; holding it was the right call.
